site.name: LuniBots
site.tagline: Self-hosted Discord bots. Free, open source, no accounts.

bots.name: Modmail
bots.tagline: Turn DMs into staff-managed support tickets.
bots.description: A Discord modmail bot. Members DM the bot and every conversation becomes a public thread in one tickets channel, where staff reply (optionally anonymously), claim, and close it. Closed tickets are archived as transcript files in a private channel and can be searched later.
features: Two-way DM to thread bridging, including edits and deletes
Claim and unclaim tickets, with alerts to a mod-help channel
Transcripts archived as Discord attachments, searchable with /logs
Rate-limit-safe thread renaming with staff fallback alerts

commands.name: /reply <message> [anonymous]
commands.description: Reply to the user from inside a ticket

commands.name: /close [reason]
commands.description: Close the ticket and generate a transcript

commands.name: /logs user <target>
commands.description: Paginated ticket history for a user

requirements: Message Content and Server Members privileged intents
A tickets channel, a private archive channel, and a staff role

bots.name: DiscMeet
bots.tagline: Record voice meetings, get structured AI notes.
bots.description: A Discord meeting note-taker. It joins your voice channel, records each speaker separately, transcribes the audio with OpenAI Whisper, strips filler words, and posts a titled, structured summary with a timed transcript to an archive channel. Also includes a per-user expense tracker with monthly budgets.
features: Per-speaker voice recording with silence-based segmentation
AI-generated title and structured meeting notes
Transcript and summary archived to a pinned log channel
Re-summarize the last session from cache
Expense tracking with categories and monthly budget

commands.name: /join
commands.description: Join your voice channel and start recording

commands.name: /summarize
commands.description: End the recording and generate AI notes

commands.name: /resummarize
commands.description: Re-run the summary on the last cached session

requirements: Discord bot token and client ID
OpenAI API key (usage billed by OpenAI)
bots.telemetry: Audio and transcripts are sent to OpenAI for transcription and summarisation. The bot itself sends nothing else.
